description: A .NET 8 SDK for Asaas Payment Gateway API
releaseNotes:
* 2.0.0 - Major release; recompile and see MIGRATION.md. Monetary amounts and tax rates are decimal instead of double (32 properties in 17 DTOs). Subscription, Installment, PaymentLink, Pix, PixTransaction and RecurringPix take typed requests and return typed responses instead of object/dynamic; Delete methods return the Asaas body. Chargebacks: GetPaymentChargebackAsync, CreateChargebackDisputeAsync (multipart) and the card brand and date filters. Fiscal info certificate, payment document and payment link image uploads send multipart/form-data. Routes now follow the Asaas reference (static Pix QR Codes, /transactions/recurrings, /images, pay QR Code); the old methods are obsolete. Path identifiers are validated and percent-encoded (null, blank, "." and ".." are rejected). ApiException exposes the errors[] items and puts their descriptions in Message. RetryConfig takes effect for GET requests only (never for POST, PUT, DELETE or uploads), Timeout applies per attempt, and BaseService.GetRetryPolicy and the Polly dependency are removed.
			* 1.5.0 - Fixed three account document endpoints (get, update and delete a file now use /v3/myAccount/documents/files/{id}; UpdateAccountDocumentAsync takes a Stream and sends multipart/form-data; removed AccountDocumentUpdateRequestDto). All service methods now forward their CancellationToken (removed the token-less ExecuteAsync overloads from BaseService). Replaced the remaining EnumMember enums with strings (AccountInfoStatus, InvoiceStatus, FiscalInfoAuthenticationType, AccountInfoCompanyType, AccountInfoPersonType, AccountInfoCityState).
			* 1.4.1 - AccountDocumentResponsibleResponseDto.Type accepts a single string as well as an array; the Asaas sends a string despite its schema, and every account documents read failed.
			* 1.4.0 - UploadAccountDocumentAsync now sends multipart/form-data to /v3/myAccount/documents/{id} and honours its cancellation token; the previous signature posted JSON to a path without the document id and never reached a valid endpoint. Removed AccountDocumentSaveRequestDto.
			* 1.3.0 - Replaced the account status and document enums with strings, since System.Text.Json does not honour EnumMemberAttribute and every SNAKE_CASE value failed to deserialize.
			* 1.2.0 - Added CPF/CNPJ filtering to ListSubaccountsAsync while preserving existing calls; updated NuGet dependencies.
			* 1.1.5 - Removed InvoiceType enum and switched property type to string.
			* 1.1.4 - Fixed Payment-related DTOs.
			* 1.1.3 - Fixed MunicipalServiceDto.
			* 1.1.2 - Implemented missing methods in FiscalService.
			* 1.1.1 - Added missing DTOs for a few services.
			* 1.1.0 - Fixed DefaultHeadersHandler ApiKey assignment.
			* 1.0.9 - Fixed DefaultHeadersHandler initialization issue.
			* 1.0.8 - Implemented missing DTOs related to Transfer and Finance services.
			* 1.0.7 - Implemented missing DTOs related to Webhook services.
			* 1.0.6 - Refactored Subaccount service to use newly created DTOs.
			* 1.0.5 - Implemented missing DTOs related to Account services.
			* 1.0.4 - Implemented missing properties for Payment and Customer get responses.
			* 1.0.3 - Implemented missing PaymentService methods.
			* 1.0.2 - Implemented missing CustomerService methods and refactored Dto classes.
			* 1.0.1 - Fixed build issues and updated Readme.
			* 1.0.0 - Initial release.
